reason.moq: MOQ too high for small orders

tip.price: Price is the most common reason. Consider lowering unit prices by 3–5% in the segments you often lose, or offering volume price tiers.
tip.leadTime: Lead time is the most common reason. Consider shortening your committed production time or offering partial deliveries for urgent orders.
tip.moq: MOQ is the most common reason. Consider accepting smaller runs with existing dies, or stating a flexible MOQ in your quotes.
tip.other: Review buyer feedback on unsuccessful bids and add any missing information (certificates, factory capability) to your profile.
